beats.speaker: pfs
beats.text: Two AI respondents: a family organizer and a router owner. Hypotheses C019–C020: ready to enable alerts if only the remaining balance is visible; monetization via retention.

beats.out: Threshold: {{boundary_months}} extra paid months × RUB 500 = +6M to the target

beats.speaker: pfs
beats.text: Situation step: what we know and from where; what we do not know and why: outage cause frequencies are not given — assumption 50/30/20, verified by pilot logs.

beats.speaker: pfs
beats.text: Options step: five substantively different options — alerts, family dashboard, routers first, status quo, close.

beats.speaker: pfs
beats.text: Red team — independent subagent: 20 hits, 15 objections plus 5 hidden assumptions. Verdict: needs rework before the pilot.

beats.speaker: pfs
beats.text: Key catch: 'confirm the payment' by the organizer contradicts the right 'the payer confirms the payment'. Reworked: reminder to the payer, three granular consents, payment incrementality with a 90-day window.

beats.speaker: human
beats.text: I approve option B — alerts. Pilot in Q1.

beats.speaker: pfs
beats.text: Choice pause closed by the decision-maker. Strategy: product and communication, 'promise — what confirms it in the product' table, conscious refusals: no geolocation, no message reading, free in the tariff.

beats.speaker: pfs
beats.text: Validation plan: pre-registration. Primary metric — extra paid months per group, ITT. Threshold: minus three percentage points of cutoff-driven restrictions. Stop metrics: consent withdrawals above 15%, double charges zero, forecast precision at least 80%.

beats.speaker: pfs
beats.text: Review: independent audit scored 46 out of 60 — five defects. All fixed: red-team hit count, scenario mismatch, target scenario from the decision boundary, timeline, consent thresholds.

beats.speaker: human
beats.text: I approve decision D001: pilot of 600 groups, review at the end of Q2.
